# Unveiling BW Marketing 40 Under 40

BW Online Bureau Oct 12, 2022

Marketing is experiencing an overhaul where technology and digitisation are continually revolutionising the business landscape. As the sector gears up to meet challenges, real change is driven by growing talent and leadership. BW Marketing World shines the spotlight on 40 future masters whose strategies and consumer insight have pushed their brands and businesses forward in their growth trajectories.
